# CC0 dedication for generated Slice evaluation fixtures

Zhang Yuancheng applies the [CC0 1.0 Universal dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode)
only to the generated WAV files and `manifest.json` in this directory.

These files are original synthetic integer PCM pulses made by
`tools/provider-benchmark/generate_sample_slice_evaluation.py`. They include no
recorded, downloaded, third-party or model-generated audio. Truth is the pulse
schedule, independent of any detector output. Source, tests and documentation
remain governed by the repository root LICENSE.
